title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by: $$y_{hat}=\theta_0+\theta_1 {x_1}^2+\theta_2 \sqrt{x_2}$$. Here, $$x_1$$ is $$dist_{from,bell}$$ and $$x_2$$ is $$section_{no}$$. Consider how each term might affect the model's bias.

title: Effect of Non-linear Terms
text: The model includes non-linear terms like $${x_1}^2$$ and $$\sqrt{x_2}$$. Non-linear terms can sometimes lead to high bias if they do not capture the true relationship well. Consider if these terms are appropriate for the data.

title: Consider Adding More Predictors
text: Adding more predictor variables can sometimes reduce bias by capturing more of the underlying patterns in the data. Think about other variables that might be relevant.

title: Regularization Techniques
text: Regularization techniques like Lasso or Ridge can help reduce overfitting, which might indirectly affect bias. However, they are more focused on reducing variance.

title: Evaluate the Suggestions
text: Evaluate whether adding more predictors or changing the model form could reduce the model bias squared.
